description.en: A shoebox-sized colour camera, about 4-5 m per pixel. Light and cheap, but it only works in daylight and sees no more than your eyes do.
description.zh-TW: 鞋盒大小的彩色相機，每個像素約 4–5 公尺。輕又便宜，但只能在白天拍，看到的和肉眼差不多。

source.title: SatCatalog: Simera Sense TriScape100; Sensors 2023, 23(13):6192
source.note: sourced: 1.1 kg, 6.0 W average; GSD 4.75 m at 500 km (sister model MultiScape100). derived: 33 GB/day = 61 Mbit/s x 72 min of imaging per day (5% duty cycle is an estimate). estimate: cost

description.en: Seven colour bands from visible to near-infrared, 1.5 m pixels. Tells healthy crops from stressed ones and water from mud. Daylight only.
description.zh-TW: 從可見光到近紅外線共 7 個波段，像素 1.5 公尺。分得出健康和缺水的作物、清水和泥水。只能白天拍。

source.title: SatCatalog: Simera Sense MultiScape200 CIS
source.note: sourced: 12.1 kg dry, 5.8 W imaging, 7 VNIR bands, GSD 1.5 at 500 km. estimate: ~41 GB/day (10 km swath and 150 s of imaging per day assumed), cost

description.en: Sees heat instead of light, so it works at night: wildfires, volcanoes, city heat islands. Its cryocooler draws steady power.
description.zh-TW: 看的是熱而不是光，所以晚上也能用：野火、火山、城市熱島。製冷機需要穩定供電。

source.title: NASA NTRS: Jhabvala et al., CTI-2 (Compact Thermal Imager 2), Table 4
source.note: sourced: mass 8 kg, cryocooler 12 W, 8.4 Mbit/s, 37 m from 410 km = 63 m from 700 km. derived: 23 GB/day at a 25% duty cycle (estimate). estimate: 25 W total power, cost

description.en: 239 narrow bands: a full spectrum for every 30 m pixel, enough to identify minerals and plant species. Heavy, power-hungry and a firehose of data.
description.zh-TW: 239 個窄波段：每個 30 公尺像素都有完整光譜，能辨認礦物和植物種類。又重又耗電，資料量像消防水管。

source.title: eoPortal: PRISMA (ASI)
source.note: sourced: instrument < 90 kg, < 110 W average, 30 m, 66 VNIR + 173 SWIR bands, 200,000 km2 per day. derived: 80 GB/day (12-bit depth assumed). estimate: cost (PRISMA's is not published), development time

description.en: Brings its own light: radar pulses see through clouds, smoke and night, 3 m strips. Floods and hurricanes are usually cloudy, so this is the instrument that still works.
description.zh-TW: 自己帶光源：雷達脈衝可以穿透雲、煙和黑夜，條帶解析度 3 公尺。洪水和颱風時通常是陰天，這時只有它照樣能用。

source.title: eoPortal: ICEYE constellation
source.note: sourced: 85 kg spacecraft, 3.2 x 0.4 m antenna, 4 kW RF peak, stripmap 3 m, 140 Mbit/s downlink. estimate: instrument share 40 kg, 150 W orbit average (a few minutes of imaging per orbit), 34 GB/day, cost

description.en: Three high-resolution spectrometers that measure carbon dioxide from sunlight reflected off the surface, the instrument built for NASA's Orbiting Carbon Observatory.
description.zh-TW: 三台高解析度光譜儀，從地表反射的陽光測量二氧化碳濃度，是為 NASA 軌道碳觀測衛星（OCO）打造的儀器。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); OCO Mishap Investigation summary
source.note: sourced: instrument 135 kg; footprint 1.29 x 2.25 km; daily return 6.75 min at 150 Mbit/s = 7.6 GB/day (derived). estimate: 100 W, $110M so the whole mission totals about the $209M mishap-report figure

name.zh-TW: 機身貼片太陽能板（0.4 m²）

description.en: Cells glued straight onto the bus. Nothing to deploy, nothing to break, but little area.
description.zh-TW: 電池片直接貼在機身上。不用展開、不會卡住，但面積很小。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 3 Power
source.note: estimate: ~3 kg/m2 for body-mounted panels; cost ~400 USD/W

description.en: Two hinged wings that unfold after launch. Three times the area, at the cost of mass and a deployment that has to work.
description.zh-TW: 發射後才展開的兩片鉸鏈翼。面積是三倍，但比較重，而且展開必須成功。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 3 Power, Table 3-2
source.note: derived: 6 kg/m2 = 340 W/m2 / 53.6-60 W/kg (Lockheed Martin SmallSat Array, GomSpace TSP). estimate: cost ~400 USD/W

description.en: About the size of OCO's array. Enough to run a big instrument through years of degradation.
description.zh-TW: 大約是 OCO 太陽能板的大小。即使衰退多年，也撐得起大型儀器。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); NASA SST-SoA Table 3-2
source.note: sourced: OCO array 'total surface area of 3.88 square meters'. derived: 6 kg/m2. estimate: cost ~400 USD/W

description.en: A CubeSat-class battery. Fine for a small load; a big load drains it deep every orbit and wears it out.
description.zh-TW: 立方衛星等級的電池。負載小沒問題；負載大時每圈都放得很深，很快就會耗損。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 3 Power, Table 3-5
source.note: sourced: packs 141.8-178.1 Wh/kg (game 145). estimate: flight-qualified cost ~200 USD/Wh

description.en: Enough for a microsatellite to ride through the shadow at shallow depth of discharge.
description.zh-TW: 足夠讓微衛星以較淺的放電深度撐過地球影子。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 3 Power, Table 3-5
source.note: derived: 400 Wh / ~148 Wh/kg. estimate: cost ~200 USD/Wh

description.en: A big pack for big loads or long shadows (GEO, lunar orbit).
description.zh-TW: 給大負載或長影子（地球同步、月球軌道）用的大電池組。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 3 Power, Table 3-5
source.note: derived: 1,500 Wh / 150 Wh/kg. estimate: cost ~200 USD/Wh

name.zh-TW: S 波段低增益天線（10 Mbps）

description.en: Simple patch antennas that work at any attitude. Reliable, but slow: fine for telemetry, tight for imagery.
description.zh-TW: 任何姿態都能通訊的簡單貼片天線。可靠但慢：傳遙測沒問題，傳影像就很吃緊。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 9 Communications, Table 9-3
source.note: sourced: S-band transmitters 1,000-20,000 kbps, 27-33 dBm, 70-250 g. estimate: 10 Mbit/s closed link, 8 W DC while transmitting (~25% PA efficiency), cost

description.en: The OCO set-up: an X-band transmitter and a body-mounted patch antenna, 15 times faster than S-band.
description.zh-TW: 和 OCO 一樣的配置：X 波段發射機加機身貼片天線，比 S 波段快 15 倍。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); NASA SST-SoA Table 9-3
source.note: sourced: 'downlinked at a rate of 150 megabits per second through the X-band transmitter and a body-mounted X-band patch antenna'; X-band transmitters 0.27-2.4 kg. estimate: 25 W DC, cost

name.zh-TW: 高速 X 波段（1 Gbps）

description.en: A modern high-rate downlink of the kind Planet flies. Empties a full recorder in one pass, but draws 50 W while it talks.
description.zh-TW: Planet 衛星用的那種新一代高速下傳。一次過境就能清空儲存，但傳輸時耗電 50 W。

source.title: eoPortal: Planet (HSD2 radio)
source.note: sourced: 1,674 Mbit/s maximum achieved on orbit, 50 W during downlink. estimate: 1 Gbit/s sustained average, mass, cost

description.en: One high-latitude antenna rented by the minute. Long gaps between contacts mean data waits on board.
description.zh-TW: 按分鐘租用一座高緯度天線。兩次通聯間隔很長，資料要在衛星上排隊等。

source.title: AWS Ground Station pricing (AWS Price List API, 2026-09-11)
source.note: sourced: wideband on-demand $22/min (Ohio, Oregon). derived: ~9 passes x 8 min x 365 days x $22 = $0.58M/yr

description.en: Three stations spread in longitude: three times the contact time and much shorter waits.
description.zh-TW: 經度分散的三座站：通聯時間三倍，等待時間短很多。

source.title: AWS Ground Station pricing (AWS Price List API, 2026-09-11)
source.note: derived: 3 x $0.58M/yr

description.en: A global network including a polar site that sees a polar orbiter on nearly every revolution.
description.zh-TW: 包含極區站的全球網路，極軌衛星幾乎每一圈都看得到。

source.title: AWS Ground Station pricing; Wikipedia: Svalbard Satellite Station
source.note: sourced: SvalSat sees low polar orbiters on every revolution. derived: 6 x $0.58M/yr

description.en: A commercial off-the-shelf board. Tiny, cheap, little storage, and only modest radiation tolerance.
description.zh-TW: 商用現成電路板。小又便宜，儲存空間少，抗輻射能力普通。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 8 Avionics, Table 8-4
source.note: sourced: EnduroSat OBC 1.5 W peak; Kryten-M3 20 krad; onboard memory 'hundreds of KB to several GB'. estimate: mass, 8 GB

name.zh-TW: 電腦 + 大容量記憶體（128 GB）

description.en: An FPGA computer with a large recorder. Holds many orbits of imagery, still commercial-grade against radiation.
description.zh-TW: FPGA 電腦加大容量記錄器。能存好幾圈的影像，抗輻射仍是商用等級。

source.title: NASA SST-SoA Table 8-4 (Aerospacelab OBC); SatCatalog MultiScape200
source.note: sourced: < 4 W, 1.325 kg; 128 GB internal storage (MultiScape200); COTS 20-40 krad (Bradford 30 krad). estimate: cost

description.en: Two radiation-hardened computers with a solid-state recorder. Survives GEO radiation and fails over automatically, but it is heavy and expensive.
description.zh-TW: 兩台抗輻射電腦加固態記錄器。撐得過地球同步軌道的輻射，壞一台會自動切換，但又重又貴。

source.title: NASA SST-SoA Table 8-4 (Aitech SP0-S); OCO launch press kit
source.note: sourced: 100 krad TID, 12 W; OCO used a RAD6000 with a 96-gigabit recorder. estimate: dual-string mass, 64 GB, cost

description.en: An all-in-one unit with three tiny reaction wheels and a star tracker. Accurate, but there is no spare wheel.
description.zh-TW: 三顆小反應輪加星象儀的一體式模組。很準，但沒有備用反應輪。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 5 GNC, Table 5-2 (BCT XACT-50)
source.note: sourced: 1.230 kg, 0.003/0.007 deg. estimate: 4 W, cost, reliability

description.en: Three wheels are needed to point; the fourth is a spare. Kepler lost two of four and nearly ended its mission.
description.zh-TW: 指向需要三顆輪子，第四顆是備用。克卜勒太空望遠鏡四顆壞了兩顆，任務差點結束。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 5 GNC, Table 5-3 (BCT RW8)
source.note: sourced: RW8 4.4 kg, 8 Nms. derived: 4 x 4.4 kg + ~2 kg of sensors. estimate: 30 W average, cost

name.zh-TW: 高精度姿態控制（4 顆大反應輪）

description.en: Big wheels for a big spacecraft and arc-second pointing, with a spare. Heavy and power-hungry.
description.zh-TW: 大衛星用的大反應輪，指向精度到角秒，含備用。又重又耗電。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 5 GNC (BCT RW16, Flexcore)
source.note: sourced: RW16 7.5 kg, 16 Nms; Flexcore 0.002 deg. derived: 4 x 7.5 kg + sensors. estimate: 50 W average, cost

description.en: Saves mass and money. The orbit is whatever the rocket gave you, and drag decides how long you stay.
description.zh-TW: 省質量也省錢。軌道就是火箭給的那個，能待多久由大氣阻力決定。

source.title: Design option
source.note: no propulsion: lifetime limited by natural orbit decay

description.en: A small non-toxic propulsion module, as flown on SkySat. About 150 m/s for a microsatellite.
description.zh-TW: SkySat 用的小型低毒推進模組。微衛星大約可以有 150 m/s 的速度變化量。

source.title: NASA SST State-of-the-Art, ch. 4 Propulsion, Table 4-3 (ECAPS SkySat 1N HPGP)
source.note: sourced: 22 kg wet, 21 kN*s total impulse, > 200 s; green monoprop 231-255 s. derived: propellant 21,000/(200 x 9.81) = 10.7 kg, dry 11.3 kg. estimate: Isp 220 s average, 3 W heaters, cost

description.en: A classic hydrazine tank and thrusters with OCO's propellant load: years of drag make-up or station keeping.
description.zh-TW: 經典的聯氨貯箱加推進器，推進劑量和 OCO 一樣：足夠多年的阻力補償或軌道維持。

source.title: OCO launch press kit (NASA/JPL 2009); NASA SST-SoA ch. 4
source.note: sourced: 'the 45 kilograms of propellant that it carries'; hydrazine thrusters 200-235 s (MR-111 219-229 s). estimate: 15 kg dry, 5 W heaters, cost

description.en: The usual electronics box. Every orbit's dose number in this game is quoted behind this much aluminium.
description.zh-TW: 一般的電子設備盒。遊戲中各軌道的輻射劑量都是以這個厚度為準。

source.title: Adell (NASA-JPL), Dose and Dose-Rate Effects in Micro-Electronics
source.note: sourced: mission doses are tabulated behind 100 mils (2.54 mm) of aluminium

description.en: Thicker walls around the computer. Halves the dose in low orbit; works even better against GEO's soft electrons.
description.zh-TW: 電腦周圍加厚。低軌道劑量減半；對地球同步軌道的軟電子效果更好。

source.title: NASA NTRS: Shields-1 PLEO Dosimetry Measurements (2022)
source.note: estimate: x0.5 per doubling of Al in LEO (penetrating protons); GEO falls faster (x0.2-0.3), simplified to one factor

description.en: A thick vault plus tantalum spot shields on the most sensitive chips. A quarter of the dose, for 8 kg.
description.zh-TW: 厚屏蔽艙加上最敏感晶片的鉭片局部屏蔽。劑量剩四分之一，代價 8 公斤。

source.title: NASA NTRS: Shields-1 PLEO Dosimetry Measurements (2022)
source.note: estimate: two doublings of shielding = x0.25
